entities.summary: Brendan Gaunce is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a forward for the Cleveland Monsters of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the Columbus Blue Jackets of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 26th overall in the 2012 NHL entry draft by the Vancouver Canucks.
